guidetextdraw_29598519._value:
Important Message About This Request

If you want to challenge a particular course, you should read and understand the policy:
guidetextdraw_29598519.name: textdraw_295985191610699202469

guidetextdraw._value:
1. Courses which may be challenged will be determined by the appropriate academic departments from classes offered during the semester in progress. Certain courses may be ineligible for Credit by Exam. 
  2. Certain General Education, major, minor courses must be taken for a letter grade. A letter grade is not available for Credit by Examination. 
  3. Credit by examination may not be used to fulfill the minimum residency requirements. 
  4. Consent by the instructor and department chair offering the course is required. 
  5. Student should be enroll in the course to be challenged. 
  6. Student must be in enrolled in a degree seeking program. 
  7. The examination must be administered no later that the end of the first week of instruction. 
  8. Upon successful completion of the examination, student will be assigned a CR (Credit) grade. 
  9. Students who fail the challenge examination may elect to continue the course for a grade or may officially withdraw from the course through the normal withdrawal procedure. 
  10. The Challenge Exam for any course can only be administered once.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1752252982250
